title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER (EO) NO. 232 DATED 19 AUGUST 2003 AND MAKING THE NORTH LUZON RAILWAYS CORPORATION (NORTHRAIL) AN AGENCY ATTACHED TO THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS (DOTC)

text.en:
Section 1 of EO No. 232 is hereby amended to read as follows:
Attachment - The North Luzon Railways Corporation
(NORTHRAIL) is hereby made an agency attached to the Department of Transportation
and Communications (DOTC).

Effectivity - This Executive Order (EO) shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this & day of February, in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Ten.
Alive M. Quigs
54222
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PGMA Holooram # 54222
